question: Does the normalized classical fusion instrument admit exact relative-sector, spin, and current representations, and what obstructs orientation quotienting and marginal-weight hard decoding?
geometry_scope: Finite planar motifs with the parent interior likelihood, rough boundaries, degree-three honeycomb and degree-four square local valences; not full finite-size lattice families or threshold estimates. The cycle has one contractible face and no logical sector.
method: Exhaust every allowed edge state and every nonzero interior record with Fraction arithmetic. Independently construct SU3 multiplicities by Dynkin-label fundamental tensor recursion and compare the parent implementation through degree four. Reconstruct compatible chains with an independent GF(2) kernel basis; compare sector sums. U1 direct signed-divergence enumeration; SU2 hidden/direct equality. Search this fixed matrix for a strict sector-Bayes versus exact-marginal matching gap, retaining ties separately.
acceptance: Every local and global probability sums exactly to one; every supported posterior normalizes.
Sector reference changes only permute labels; binary kernel parameterization is bijective.
SU2 hidden and directed joint record/activity laws agree exactly on all fixtures.
At least one explicit U1/SU3 record or sector counterexample rejects an orientation-independent quotient.
U1 current-sector enumeration matches the full likelihood; degree-three and degree-four SU(N) weights are retained.
Give a strict matched hardening counterexample if found; otherwise retain a mathematical risk bound without claiming a numerical counterexample.
Record browser/report/registry verification separately from algebraic verification.
stop_rule: Any identity failure blocks its scientific claim and downstream use; repair transparently or report obstruction. No fitted critical parameters.

supplementary_validation.selection: All 21 first strict witnesses from the already fixed matrix, identified before backend evaluation; all physical U1 states on original fixtures for integral-cycle reconstruction.
checks: Compare PyMatching exact-marginal correction with the exact surrogate objective, retaining any backend mismatch as a separate limitation.
Verify parent BP tree marginals for degree-four-star witnesses with tolerance 1e-10, 100 sweeps, zero damping.
Construct integer fundamental-cycle basis after collapsing unmeasured endpoints; reconstruct all U1 state differences from chord coordinates.
supplementary_validation.budget: one process, under 2 minutes; no additional Monte Carlo
supplementary_validation.post_result_followup: Backend star mismatch triggered a read-only repeated detector-column audit on both canonical parent geometries at L=5,7,9,11; no decoder or channel changes.

interpretation: Exact model identities pass. Strict ideal hardening witnesses found; six hexagon witnesses reproduce PyMatching, 15 star examples expose a separate parallel-boundary-edge backend limitation.
